# Feature 091 Adaptive Corpus

Each fixture records the response, extracted evidence, supported domains, outcome, next action, facts not inferred, and expected prose.

- Very small non-technical organization: owner-managed technology; do not infer specialist teams.
- Small technology startup: technology is central to the business; ask deeper questions only when an FR-005 behavior category can change.
- Small-to-medium organization with dedicated IT: do not infer security, architecture, or governance functions from IT alone.
- Large enterprise: explore specialized responsibilities only when evidence can alter future guidance.

A response may support multiple domains. Identical inputs produce identical proposal bytes. Unknown,
unrelated, or declined responses remain `not_discussed` unless the user explicitly establishes a boundary.
